SVG to PNG Converter

Paste SVG code or upload an .svg file and rasterize it to PNG at any size.

📄 Or drop an .svg file here or click to browse

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste SVG code or upload an .svg file.
  2. Set the output width and height.
  3. Click Download PNG to save it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the conversion work?

Your SVG is drawn to a canvas at your chosen width and height, then exported as a PNG.

Can I paste code or upload a file?

Type or paste code into the box, or upload an .svg file — both work.

What output size can I get?

Set any width and height; the SVG scales crisply since it is vector.
